key_difference: (D) passes its completeness tag through to is_complete via qTryMetaTypeInterfaceForType, but the tag is the named `QtPrivate::ConnectionTypesDefaultTag`, which is the same in every translation unit; (B) uses an anonymous-namespace `UniqueType`, so (D) still allows the cross-TU folding of the wrong completeness result that the reviewer demonstrated, and it also widens `QMetaTypeIdQObject` with gadget and QObject-pointer specializations that (B) did not need.
